title: Malformed-plan fail-closed verification component
responsibilities: Execute the malformed-plan verification over the accepted decoder.
Prove structural fail-closed rejection and the absence of a decoded value on every malformed defect.
state_ownership: none; the component holds no state and owns no runtime resource
concurrency: offline-single-threaded; one test process, no thread, no mutable shared state
errors: GoogleTest assertion failure on an accepted defect, a wrong code/target, or a returned value on a breach
deployment: repository-local test process; no runtime deployment and no activation
rationale: The accepted fail-closed plan boundary is exercised where it is consumed; no decoder or schema is created by T020.
